5.eng-name: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: Rapporté par Ibn ‘Umar : J’ai entendu le Prophète (ﷺ) dire depuis la chaire : “Celui qui vient au vendredi, qu’il prenne un bain.”

chapter.ara-name: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.eng-name: What was narrated concerning bath on Friday
